'''''Shadow''''' can refer to the following:

* The [[Shadow]] - a force of evil in the world.

==Books and chapters==
* ''[[The Shadow Rising]]'' - the fourth book of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 19|Shadow's Waiting]]'' - the nineteenth chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 30|Children of Shadow]]'' - the thirtieth chapter of ''The Eye of the World''.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 32|Four Kings in Shadow]]'' - the thirty-second chapter of ''The Eye of the World''.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 45|What Follows in Shadow]]'' - the forty-fifth chapter of ''The Eye of the World''.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 51|Against the Shadow]]'' - the fifty-first chapter of ''The Eye of the World''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Prologue|In the Shadow]]'' - the prologue of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 5|The Shadow in Shienar]]'' - the fifth chapter of ''The Great Hunt''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 27|The Shadow in the Night]]'' - the twenty-seventh chapter of ''The Great Hunt''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 46|To Come Out of the Shadow]]'' - the forty-sixth chapter of ''The Great Hunt''.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 4|Shadows Sleeping]]'' - the fourth chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 43|Shadowbrothers]]'' - the forty-third chapter of ''The Dragon Reborn''.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 46|A Message Out of the Shadow]]'' - the forty-sixth chapter of ''The Dragon Reborn''.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 47|To Race the Shadow]]'' - the forty-seventh chapter of ''The Dragon Reborn''.
* ''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 1|Seeds of Shadow]]'' - the first chapter of ''The Shadow Rising''.
* ''[[The Fires of Heaven/Chapter 3|Pale Shadows]]'' - the third chapter of ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]''.
* ''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 6|Threads Woven of Shadow]]'' - the sixth chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
* ''[[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 32|Rivers of Shadow]]'' - the thirty-second chapter of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.

==Others==
* ''[[Atha'an Shadar]]'' - the [[Seanchan]] name for [[Darkfriend]]s, meaning "People of the Shadow" in the [[Old Tongue]].
* [[Shaidar Haran]] - a unique and very powerful Myrddraal with many special abilities, whose name means "Hand of the Shadow" in the Old Tongue. 
* ''[[Dance with Jak o' the Shadows]]'' - a song.
* [[Forest of Shadows]] - a [[:Category:Forests|forest]] between the [[Two Rivers]] and [[Ghealdan]].
* [[Prophecies of the Shadow]] - [[Foretelling]]s presumably made by [[Aes Sedai]] who follow the [[Dark One]].
* [[Shadar Logoth]] - an abandoned city, whose name means "Place Where the Shadow Waits," or "Shadow's Waiting," in the Old Tongue.
* ''shadar'' and ''shaidar'' - two words in the Old Tongue that mean shadow, the second being used by a conscious entity.
* [[Darkhound|Shadowbrother]] - the [[wolves]]' name for Darkhounds.
* [[Shadow Coast]] - the southwest coastline of the [[Westlands]].
* [[Dragon Reborn|Shadowkiller]] - the wolves' name for the Dragon Reborn.
* [[Shadowspawn]] - creatures created by servants of the Dark One.
* [[War of the Shadow]] - another name for the War of Power.
* [[Darkfriend|Shadowrunners]] - the Aiel name for Darkfriends.
* [[Forsaken|Shadowsouled]] - the [[Aiel]] name for the Forsaken.
* Shadowwrought - the Aiel name for Shadowspawn.
